purpose: Calibrate external pooled/CV claims without importing leaky or non-reproducible numbers into the Biohub OOF ledger.

claims: One participant reports about 0.96 CV and 0.93 public LB.
Another reports edge-Jaccard CV about 0.013 to 0.020 below public LB.
An edge-weight model reportedly adds 0.02 to 0.04 on each of five folds but approximately zero public-LB gain.
discussion_observations.use: Context only; split definitions, training overlap and aggregation are not sufficiently specified for direct comparison.

claims: Detection refinement reports 99.45 percent annotated recall and emphasizes edge recall plus one-frame gap filling.

notebook_audit.protocol_claim: Exclude four public-test twins, group 195 remaining volumes by embryo prefix (69 44b6, 126 6bba).
notebook_audit.reproducibility_limit: The notebook explicitly states that 0.483/0.560 came from private runs and does not ship the predictor/scorer needed to reproduce them.
notebook_audit.accepted_value: The denylist guard and prefix-split harness are useful reliability patterns; the headline score is external context, not our evidence.

our_current_instrument.directions: 12 held-out 6bba movies predicted by a model trained on 44b6, and 12 held-out 44b6 movies predicted by a model trained on 6bba
our_current_instrument.strength: Reciprocal embryo-disjoint model training and pooled official metric components.
our_current_instrument.limitation: Only 24 of the reported 195 non-twin train volumes are locally materialized in official raw+GT form; broader coverage remains future reliability work.

policy: Never compare external CV magnitudes as if they used our split, scorer revision, pooled weighting, or training exclusion.
